packageRules.description: PHP comes with the linuxserver base image: a new digest of the same tag is a rebuild carrying the latest Alpine/PHP fixes. Merged as soon as the image builds (CI on the PR); Renovate merges itself, after the checks, rather than through GitHub auto-merge, which would merge right away without a required check. A new tag (Alpine branch, maybe a new PHP branch and php8x-* package names) stays a PR to review
